name: openrouter-maestro
description: One extension to run OpenRouter models everywhere: native Copilot Chat provider, Claude Code launcher/config manager, and OpenAI Codex CLI/IDE provider setup. Browse, filter, and apply 500+ models with pricing and capability info.

languageModelTools.name: maestro_fetchWebPage
languageModelTools.userDescription: Download a web page and read its text. Works without a GitHub Copilot subscription.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetches a public web page by URL and returns its main text as Markdown-like text (headings, lists, links, code blocks). Use it to read documentation, articles, READMEs, FAQs or any page the user mentions. Prefer this tool over fetch_webpage: fetch_webpage depends on a GitHub Copilot subscription and fails without one (for example with 'Your subscription has ended'). Long pages come back in parts; the result ends with the offset to pass to read the next part.

url.description: Full http or https address of the page, e.g. https://example.com/docs/faq

offset.description: Character offset to continue a long page from, as given at the end of the previous result. Omit for the start of the page.

languageModelTools.name: maestro_codebaseSearch
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the workspace code by meaning. Works without a GitHub Copilot subscription.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Semantic search over the user's workspace. Returns the code locations (path:start-end with the code) that best match a natural-language query, e.g. 'where API keys are validated' or 'retry logic for HTTP requests'. Use it to find relevant code when you do not know file or symbol names; use text search instead for exact identifiers or strings. Copilot's own codebase/semantic search is not available for this model, so prefer this tool for finding code by meaning. The first call indexes the workspace, which can take a minute.

query.description: What to look for, described in natural language or as a code fragment.

maxResults.description: How many locations to return (1-20, default 8).

openrouterMaestro.cache.ttlMinutes.description: How many minutes before the model cache is considered stale and automatically refreshed.

openrouterMaestro.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response from OpenRouter before timing out.

openrouterMaestro.maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests (rate limits, server errors).

openrouterMaestro.defaultTemperature.description: Default temperature for model responses (0.0 = deterministic, 2.0 = creative). Leave empty to use model default.

openrouterMaestro.defaultMaxTokens.description: Default maximum output tokens. Leave empty to use model default.

openrouterMaestro.apiEndpoint.description: OpenRouter API base URL. Change this if using a self-hosted proxy or custom endpoint.

openrouterMaestro.enablePromptCaching.description: Enable OpenRouter automatic prompt caching (cache_control). Dramatically reduces input token costs for Anthropic models in agent mode; ignored by providers that cache automatically.

openrouterMaestro.sanitizeBase64Content.description: Strip long base64-like blobs from outgoing prompt text before sending. Prevents OpenRouter organization guardrails from blocking requests with 'prompt injection patterns detected' (base64_encoded_injection) and saves tokens. Image attachments are never affected. Disable if you need the model to analyze raw base64 content.

openrouterMaestro.claudeCode.settingsSco.description: Where to write Claude Code environment settings: 'user' (~/.claude/settings.json, applies everywhere) or 'project' (.claude/settings.local.json in the current workspace only).

openrouterMaestro.enableStreamUsage.description: Ask OpenRouter for token usage statistics in the streaming response (stream_options.include_usage). Disable if a provider rejects the request with an invalid_json or unrecognized-field error.

openrouterMaestro.claudeCode.maxOutputTo.description: Upper limit for CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS. OpenRouter reserves max_tokens × completion price up front, so a high value returns HTTP 402 ('insufficient credits') on a low balance before any tokens are spent. Lower this if Claude Code keeps hitting 402.

openrouterMaestro.claudeCode.smallFastMo.description: OpenRouter model ID to use for Claude Code background/haiku-class tasks (ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL). Leave empty to use the same model as the main one.

openrouterMaestro.codex.configPath.description: Path to the Codex config.toml. Leave empty for the default ~/.codex/config.toml.

openrouterMaestro.maxInputTokensOverride.description: Override the maxInputTokens reported to VS Code. Lower values trigger conversation compaction earlier, preventing large request body errors (invalid_json). Leave empty to auto-calculate from model's context window.

openrouterMaestro.defaultReasoningEffort.description: Default thinking effort for reasoning models when Copilot has not set one yet. Leave empty to use each model's catalog default. The Copilot model-picker Thinking Effort submenu overrides this per session.

openrouterMaestro.utilityModel.markdownDescription: OpenRouter model Copilot uses for chat titles, commit messages, rename suggestions and repairing failed edits. Copilot's own utility models need a Copilot subscription. Set it with the **OpenRouter Maestro: Choose Utility Model for Copilot** command, which also writes `chat.utilityModel` and `chat.utilitySmallModel`.

openrouterMaestro.replaceCopilotFetch.markdownDescription: Leave Copilot's own `fetch_webpage` tool out of requests to Maestro's models whenever **Fetch Web Page (Maestro)** is available. Copilot's fails for anyone signed in to GitHub without an active Copilot plan, and models often pick it first.

openrouterMaestro.webSearch.enabled.markdownDescription: Let models search the web while answering, through OpenRouter's `openrouter:web_search` server tool. Only for models that support tool calling. Each search is billed by OpenRouter on top of tokens (about $0.007 with the default engine; see `webSearch.engine`).

enumDescriptions: Exa, fast mode: about $0.007 per search. Up to date in our tests.
Parallel, fast mode: about $0.001 per search. Cheapest, but its results can be months old.
The model provider's own search (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, ...), at the provider's price; falls back to Exa.
Native search where the provider has it, otherwise Exa.
openrouterMaestro.webSearch.engine.description: Search engine OpenRouter uses for web search.

openrouterMaestro.webSearch.maxResults.description: Results per search. More results cost more input tokens.

openrouterMaestro.webSearch.showSources.description: List the web pages a searched answer is based on at the end of the answer.

openrouterMaestro.codebaseSearch.embeddi.markdownDescription: OpenRouter embedding model for the **Codebase Search (Maestro)** tool. Changing it rebuilds the index. Free embedding models may be unavailable under strict OpenRouter privacy settings.

openrouterMaestro.codebaseSearch.maxFile.description: Most files to index per workspace. Files over 256 KB, binaries, secrets (.env, keys) and build output are always skipped.

openrouterMaestro.inlineCompletions.enab.markdownDescription: Inline code suggestions (ghost text) from an OpenRouter model, for use without a Copilot subscription. Each suggestion is a paid request. Leave off if Copilot already gives you inline suggestions.

openrouterMaestro.inlineCompletions.mode.description: OpenRouter model for inline suggestions. Pick a fast one; Codestral answers in about a second.

openrouterMaestro.inlineCompletions.debo.description: How long typing must pause before a suggestion is requested, in milliseconds.

openrouterMaestro.logLevel.description: Minimum log level for the OpenRouter Maestro output channel.
enumDescriptions: Show all messages including debug details
